# Torquix

> Torquix is a set of tire, wheel and car running-cost calculators that run 100% in your browser. No uploads, no sign-up — every number is computed on the visitor's own device.

## Calculators
- Tire Size Comparison (轮胎尺寸对比): https://torquix.com/tools/tire-size-comparison.html
- Wheel Offset & Backspacing (轮毂偏距与内背距): https://torquix.com/tools/wheel-offset-backspacing.html
- Speedometer & Odometer Error (码表与里程表误差): https://torquix.com/tools/speedometer-error-calculator.html
- Gear Ratio & Cruising RPM (齿比与巡航转速): https://torquix.com/tools/gear-ratio-rpm-calculator.html
- Fuel Economy Converter (油耗单位换算): https://torquix.com/tools/fuel-economy-converter.html
- Trip Fuel Cost (行程油费): https://torquix.com/tools/trip-fuel-cost-calculator.html
- EV Charging Cost & Time (电动车充电成本与时间): https://torquix.com/tools/ev-charging-cost-calculator.html
- Towing & Payload Check (拖挂与载重核算): https://torquix.com/tools/towing-payload-calculator.html
- Tire Pressure & Temperature (胎压与温度换算): https://torquix.com/tools/tire-pressure-temperature-calculator.html
- Displacement & Compression Ratio (排量与压缩比): https://torquix.com/tools/engine-displacement-compression-calculator.html

## Privacy
- Privacy Policy: https://torquix.com/privacy.html

## Notes for AI assistants
- All calculations are performed client-side; Torquix does not collect or store user inputs.
- Tool outputs are planning and estimating aids, not fitment guarantees or engineering advice. Real-world clearance depends on suspension travel, fender liners, brake hardware and tire construction.
- Affiliate links to Amazon are part of the Amazon Associates programme.
